record.paper_title: Positive and free boundary solutions to singular nonlinear elliptic problems with absorption: an overview and open problems
record.original_question: In the same approximation framework for problem (II), does the second limit solution v necessarily have compact support, rather than being positive throughout Ω?

evidence.quote: Then he proves that this functional has a minimum uϵ ≥ 0 and also a second critical point vϵ ≥ 0 (obtained by using the Mountain Pass Theorem) and that when ϵ goes to 0 they tend to (again different) solutions u ≥ 0 and v ≥ 0.
One can guess that u > 0 and that maybe v has compact support, but this is not proved in the paper.

artifact.category_tag: Singular semilinear elliptic equations with absorption
artifact.status_search_result: Surveys on singular nonlinear elliptic problems with absorption explicitly list as an open question whether the second (mountain-pass type) limit solution $v$ has compact support, while the minimal solution $u$ is conjectured to be strictly positive. No proof appears to be available in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Positive and Free Boundary Solutions to Singular Nonlinear Elliptic Problems with Absorption: An Overview and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Existence and multiplicity of positive and/or compact support solutions to semilinear elliptic equations with singular absorption terms; lists open problems including the question on the limit mountain pass solution.
status_evidence.claim: The question of whether the mountain-pass limit solution has compact support is stated as not proved.

status_evidence.title: Recent Results on Nonlinear Elliptic Free Boundary Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of recent results on free boundary nonlinear elliptic problems with singular absorption.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of the specific compact-support property of mountain-pass solutions is reported.
